description: Steam store page for a game or app by numeric appid: current price (final and list price, discount percent, currency; set cc to a country code such as de for EUR or us for USD), release date, genres, developers, platforms, Metacritic score, description and DLC. Answers 'current price of Cyberpunk 2077 on Steam in EUR', 'is this game on sale on Steam', 'what genres is appid 1091500'. Takes the appid (the number in a game's Steam store address), not a game name. Current price only: no price history and no lowest-ever price. Source: Valve, Steam store.

cc.description: Two-letter country code that sets the price currency, e.g. "de" for EUR, "us" for USD, "gb" for GBP. Default: the store default.

l.description: Language for the text fields, e.g. "english".

name: app_details

properties.description: Store API returns appid keys with app detail objects

title: App Details
